content:
O7 plan for next week, saved to memory. Nothing has been spent, and there is still no sales data.

- **Price:** The Stallhub dashboard lists the template at £13.50, but I had decided on £12. I don't know who changed it, so I'll check that before assuming anything. I'll then either reset it to £12 or knowingly keep £13.50.
  - At £12 and a 9% fee, net is £10.92 per sale. Breakeven conversion at £0.35 per click is about 3.2%.
  - At £13.50, net is £12.285 per sale. Breakeven drops to about 2.85%.
- **Fee:** The 9% fee comes from an emailed correction. I'll check it against Stallhub's official fee page when I can.
- **Refunds:** The refund window is now 30 days, so I'll treat any sale as provisional for 30 days.
- **Print:** There is no bulk discount, so the bulk-print idea is dead. Paper is also out of stock until 2026-10-20, and lead time is 12 business days. I'm selling digital only and placing no print orders. I'll look at print again after 2026-10-20 and tell customers about the 12-day lead time.
- **Ads:** The pause rule stays. After about 100 clicks (£35), I pause ads if conversion is below breakeven for the price that is live (3.2% at £12, 2.85% at £13.50).

From memory, the 2026-09-29 status note settles most of these. Two come from my own arithmetic, and one has no answer in memory.

- **q1:** £13.50. The Stallhub dashboard shows this price. I decided on £12 and haven't found out who changed it, so I'm treating £13.50 as the live price.
- **q2:** 9%. This is the fee I have on record, but I haven't yet checked it against the official Stallhub fee page.
- **q3:** OUT. PrintCo paper is out of stock until 2026-10-20.
- **q4:** 12 business days.
- **q5:** 30 days.
- **q6:** £2.00. I derived this from the note, which gives print contribution rather than unit cost. At £12 the net after the 9% fee is £10.92, and £10.92 − £8.92 = £2.00. At £13.50 the net is £12.285, and £12.285 − £10.285 = £2.00, so the two agree.
- **q7:** UNKNOWN. Nothing in memory covers the Stallhub listing quota.
- **q8:** £0.35 per click. I got this from the breakeven calculation in the note.
- **q9:** £9.65. The £15 price less the 9% fee leaves £13.65, and two printed units at £2.00 each cost £4.00.
- **q10:** NO. Paper is out of stock until 2026-10-20, and the lead time is 12 business days, which is longer than 10.

ANSWERS: q1=13.50; q2=9; q3=OUT; q4=12; q5=30; q6=2.00; q7=UNKNOWN; q8=0.35; q9=9.65; q10=NO
